description: This Scala source file defines an abstract class `ThreadSafeDittoLoggingAdapter` that extends Akka's `LoggingAdapter` with additional thread-safe logging capabilities, particularly for setting and managing correlation IDs within the MDC (Mapped Diagnostic Context). It provides methods to associate, derive, and discard correlation IDs for logging purposes, facilitating structured and context-aware logging in concurrent environments.

classes.name: ThreadSafeDittoLoggingAdapter
classes.description: An abstract class extending Akka's `LoggingAdapter`, providing thread-safe methods to manage correlation IDs for logging, supporting setting, deriving from headers, and discarding correlation IDs.

methods.name: withCorrelationId
methods.description: Sets a correlation ID for log operations on the returned logger, or discards it if null or empty.

methods.name: withCorrelationId (overload)
methods.description: Derives the correlation ID from given `WithDittoHeaders`, returning a logger with that ID set or none if unavailable.

methods.name: withCorrelationId (another overload)
methods.description: Obtains and sets the correlation ID directly from the provided `DittoHeaders`, or discards it if absent or empty.

methods.name: discardCorrelationId
methods.description: Removes the currently set correlation ID so that subsequent logs will not include one.
